name: Norka
description:
Imagine a hassle-free text-writing experience.
Don't worry about saving files, complex markup, or accidentally deleted notes.

Do what you want to do - concentrate on beautiful stories, short notes, or inspired scripts.
Norka cares about you.

• All your notes are stored inside.

• Magically saved at any moment.

• Easily exportable to HTML, Docx, and even PDF in one click.

• If you need markup - use markdown, it's easy as pie.

• Don't like the default theme - choose differently.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
